title: The Corps has decided your Breathing style
dek: Demon Slayer, with no trivia. Twelve questions about how you fight and what you would die for, then the Corps hands you a Breathing style and a blade.

results.name: WATER BREATHING
results.tagline: Eleven forms, and you only need the right one
results.blurb: You are the steady one: adaptable, calm, and quietly relentless. You read a situation before you move, you change form to suit the fight instead of making the fight suit you, and you are usually the person others copy their technique from. Nothing about you is flashy. Everything about you works.
strengths: The person everyone else learns from
results.watchOut: You keep absorbing other people's fights. Pick one that is only yours.

results.name: FLAME BREATHING
results.tagline: Set your heart ablaze, and mean it
results.blurb: You lead from the front and you do it loudly enough that nobody has to guess what you believe. Your energy is genuinely infectious, your standards are absurd, and you would absolutely take a hit that was meant for someone else. People remember the exact thing you said to them years later.
strengths: Makes people braver by standing near them
results.watchOut: You burn hot enough to forget your own limits. Rest before someone makes you.

results.name: THUNDER BREATHING
results.tagline: One form. It has never failed you
results.blurb: You are not the loudest person in the room, right up until the moment you are the only one moving. Most of the time you are anxious, overthinking, apologising for existing. Then something clicks and you do the one thing you can do better than anyone alive, and everyone stops talking.
results.watchOut: You wait to be scared before you commit. Move before the fear arrives.

results.name: INSECT BREATHING
results.tagline: Precision, a smile, and something in the blade
results.blurb: You are the one who solved it in the planning, not the fighting. Small, exact, patient, and considerably more dangerous than anyone gives you credit for, because you never announce the part that matters. You are extremely polite right up until the exact second it becomes unnecessary.
results.watchOut: You carry things alone that you could share. Let someone in on the plan.

results.name: MIST BREATHING
results.tagline: You were never quite where they thought
results.blurb: You move through the world slightly out of phase with it: hard to pin down, harder to predict, and entirely unbothered by what people expect. You can be devastatingly effective and then forget the conversation entirely. Some people find you cold. The ones who matter find you restful.
results.watchOut: You drift out of rooms, plans and friendships without noticing. Say where you're going.

results.name: SOUND BREATHING
results.tagline: If it's worth doing, it's worth being loud about
results.blurb: You are flashy on purpose and excellent on purpose, and you have never understood why anyone would pretend otherwise. You bring the music, the plan, the three backup plans and the good jewellery. Under all of it you are the most reliable person in the group and the first to notice someone is not okay.
strengths: Shows up with a plan and a good time
results.watchOut: You hide the serious part behind the performance. Say the plain thing.

results.name: STONE BREATHING
results.blurb: You are the one nothing gets through. Not stubbornness exactly: more a deep, quiet certainty that you will still be standing when the noise stops. You train longer than everyone, you say less, and when you finally move, the ground has already lost the argument.
results.watchOut: Being immovable can look like being unavailable. Let people lean on you out loud.

results.name: WIND BREATHING
results.tagline: Sharp, scarred, and not interested in excuses
results.blurb: You are blunt, fast and furiously protective, and your kindness comes out sideways as criticism. You have been through something that took pieces of you and you decided, instead of softening, to get sharper. Nobody doubts where they stand with you. That is a rarer gift than being nice.
results.watchOut: You cut people who were not attacking you. Aim once, then put it down.

results.name: LOVE BREATHING
results.tagline: Six forms, all whip-crack, all heart
results.blurb: You are warm, strong and completely unembarrassed about loving the people around you. Your style is flexible and surprising, built out of care rather than aggression, and it is much more dangerous than it looks. Everyone underestimates you at first. Everyone stops doing that.
results.watchOut: You'll take on everyone's feelings before your own. Put yourself on the list.

results.name: BEAST BREATHING
results.tagline: Eleven forms, invented in the woods, no notes
results.blurb: You were never taught any of this. You worked it out by doing it badly, repeatedly, at volume, until it worked. You are instinctive, competitive, weirdly good in a crisis, and you refuse to be told that something is impossible. Your technique is ugly and effective and entirely your own.
strengths: Builds things nobody else would try
results.watchOut: You charge before the plan exists. Let someone else say one sentence first.
